ios.name: Build IPA for Device
ios.description: Build {flavor} IPA for direct device install (development signing)

ios.name: Build & Upload IPA
ios.description: Build + upload IPA to TestFlight for {flavor}
ios.command_template: flutter build ipa --release --flavor {flavor} && ipatool upload --bundle-id {bundle_id} --apple-id {apple_id} --path build/ios/ipa/*.ipa

android.name: Build & Upload AAB
android.description: Build + publish {flavor} AAB to Play Store internal testing

android.name: Upload AAB only
android.description: Publish already-built {flavor} AAB to Play Store internal testing

combined.name: Build & Deploy Both (iOS + Android)
combined.description: Build + upload BOTH iOS and Android for {flavor} in one run - version/build number is bumped once and shared by both platforms

release.name: 1. Preview Changelog (Dry-run)
release.description: Analyze {app_id} and dependent packages, print preview (zero files or git changes)

release.name: 2. Update CHANGELOG.md Only
release.description: Analyze and update CHANGELOG.md in {app_id} and packages (no git commit/tag)

release.name: 3. Update Changelog & Git Commit
release.description: Update CHANGELOG.md and commit to local branch (no tag/push)

release.name: 4. Changelog + Commit + Local Git Tag
release.description: Update CHANGELOG.md, commit, and create local annotated Git tag (no remote push)

release.name: 5. Full Release (Tag & Push to Remote)
release.description: Update CHANGELOG.md, commit, create Git tag, and push commit & tag to remote repository

release.name: 6. Bump Patch (SemVer) & Release
release.description: Auto-bump PATCH version (e.g. 1.0.5 -> 1.0.6), compile changelog, and create local tag

release.name: 7. Bump Minor (SemVer) & Release
release.description: Auto-bump MINOR version (e.g. 1.0.5 -> 1.1.0), compile changelog, and create local tag

release.name: 8. Bump Major (SemVer) & Release
release.description: Auto-bump MAJOR version (e.g. 1.0.5 -> 2.0.0), compile changelog, and create local tag

release.name: 9. Store 'What's New' Release Notes
release.description: Generate clean, consumer-friendly release notes formatted for App Store & Google Play Console

release.name: 10. Pre-Flight Verify & Full Release
release.description: Run flutter analyze & test pre-flight check, compile changelog, create tag, and push to remote

release.name: 11. Monorepo Unreleased Report
release.description: Scan entire workspace and display all unreleased commits across all apps and packages

release.name: 12. Rollback / Delete Release Tag
release.description: Delete accidental local Git release tag and provide rollback commands
